turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm hosting a game night Friday. There'll be six of us, and two have never really played board games.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fun! Do you want one easy party game everyone can join, or two smaller groups playing different games?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Moshi, could you stay silent for a bit? I need a word with Daniel. I'll tell you when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Daniel, did you get the bill from the restaurant on Saturday?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, I paid it all on my card. You owe me for yours.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: You had the steak and two glasses of wine, so a bit more than half.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ouch. Can I send it on Friday? Payday.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Friday's fine. Just don't forget like last time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you lock the front door?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, I locked it when I came in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Back again. What were we talking about?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. We were planning your game night for six.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, something else. I've been reading the same page for ten minutes.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sounds like your brain's somewhere else. Are you tired, or is the book just not grabbing you?
